choices.zh: 八戒睡在一些灌木后面。

answer_evidence.quote: The pig lay down behind some bushes.
Soon he was snoring loudly.
He peered behind some bushes and saw the pig fast asleep.
"May I have more tofu?" asked Bajie.
He was talking in his sleep.
"Yes, please cook lots more. I will eat it all."
But when they got there, the Tang Monk was gone.
The monster laughed.
"I have a monk here. I'm going to eat him for dinner!"

prompt.en: what did the tang monk send bajie to do?

answer_evidence.quote: "Bajie," said the Tang Monk.
"Why don't you go find us some food? Wujing and I will wait here."
The pig moaned. "Ugh! I just sat down!"
Then he wandered off.

prompt.en: what did the tang monk find in the forest?
prompt.zh: 唐僧在森林里发现了什么？

answer_evidence.quote: Meanwhile the Tang Monk became bored.
The monk walked quietly through the woods, admiring flowers and plants as he went.
He went deeper and deeper into the forest.
Then, in the midst of all the trees, he saw a pagoda.
"This is a strange place for a pagoda," he thought.
